scope: pulldown on enzymes targeted by serine hydrolase probes tetrahydrolipstatin-biotin and fluorophosphonate biotin probe

A total of 10 µL slurry (suspension of 50% high-capacity streptavidin beads, Thermo Fisher 20361) and 30 µL slurry (suspension of 50% control agarose beads, Thermo Fisher 26150) were used for each sample.
The beads were agitated by overhead turning (2 h, RT). Afterwards, the samples were centrifuged (3000 µg, 2 min) and the supernatant discarded by pouring out.
The beads were resuspended in 100 µL digestion buffer containing 0.25 µg trypsin (Promega), and protein was digested overnight at 37°C
